# Attractions

```{python}
#| echo: false
import pandas as pd
import plotly.express as px

attractions = pd.read_csv("data/attractions.csv")
visits = pd.read_csv("data/visits.csv")
churches = pd.read_csv("data/churches.csv")
top = attractions.loc[attractions["visits_2025"].idxmax()]
total = int(attractions["visits_2025"].sum())
n_free = int(attractions["admission"].str.startswith("Free").sum())
```

## Row {height=20%}

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Top attraction (2025, ALVA)"
dict(icon="trophy", color="primary", value=top["attraction"])
```

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Total visits_2025 (ALVA member attractions)"
dict(icon="people", color="secondary", value=f"{total:,}")
```

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Attractions with free general admission"
dict(icon="ticket", color="success", value=n_free)
```

## Row {height=80%}

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| title: "Visits in 2025 by attraction (ALVA)"
d = attractions.sort_values("visits_2025")
fig = px.bar(d, x="visits_2025", y="attraction", orientation="h",
             labels={"visits_2025": "Visits in 2025", "attraction": ""})
fig = fig.update_layout(margin=dict(l=0, r=0, t=10, b=0))
fig
```

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| title: "Visits by year, five sights (ALVA)"
fig = px.line(visits, x="year", y="visits", color="attraction",
              labels={"visits": "Visits", "year": "Year", "attraction": "Attraction"})
fig = fig.update_layout(margin=dict(l=0, r=0, t=10, b=0))
fig
```

# Churches

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| title: "Churches and cathedrals (Visit London)"
from IPython.display import Markdown
rows = ["| Church | Type |", "|:--|:--|"]
for _, r in churches.iterrows():
    rows.append(f"| [{r['church']}]({r['visit_london']}) | {r['type']} |")
Markdown("\n".join(rows))
```

Sources: ALVA (`data/attractions.csv`, `data/visits.csv`) and Visit London (`data/churches.csv`); see the `source` and `url` columns.
